mechanism: Several generic bisections share one quadratic carrier, whose rational lift simultaneously supplies points on a specialized fibre.
selection: First sixteen distinct bisection labels in lexicographic order; use only generic quadratic-cover coefficient arrays. Verify the atlas bytes against the committed deep-cover certificate binding at capture. No exceptional point, score or split-fibre list enters this dictionary.

pairs.scope: published R17; historic +11 versus censored Nagao control
published R17; historic +10 versus censored Nagao control
published R17; coefficient-scale-matched recent +7 versus observed zero

primary_test: Does this dictionary contain at least three bisections in the same nontrivial Q(t) squareclass, with all three discriminants nonzero rational squares at at least one fixed high fibre?
negative_endpoint: An empty common group or no split high specialization exactly refutes this particular sixteen-bisection shared-carrier explanation. It does not refute carriers outside the dictionary, coordinated solubility without a shared carrier, or rank jumps on any control.
positive_endpoint: A positive square test is only simultaneous rational-lift evidence. Require exact lifted-point maps and at least three independent directions modulo the generic group before calling it a soluble MW block; no automatic success or selector promotion.
secondary_test: Compare individual rational split counts and accidental same-squareclass values on the six fixed fibres descriptively. No population frequency or p-value.
failure_semantics: Zero discriminant is DEGENERATE, not a soluble independent lift. Missing coefficient data, timeout or failed identity is INCONCLUSIVE. Preserve this protocol and all inputs.
